lead: No plans side by side and no columns to align. The panel states one price, the action that goes with it and what the price covers.
note: The note lists the terms of the price: tax, deposit, minimum term.

included.title: The price can be a word
included.text: “On request” fits the same place as a figure.

included.title: The buttons sit under the price
included.text: The decision comes before the detail.

included.title: Rows say what the price covers
included.text: Each row has a labelled mark.

included.title: A value can end a row
included.text: For a rate or a limit that belongs to one row.

included.title: Excluded rows stay in the list
included.text: So it is clear what the price leaves out.
